name: tape_drive
author: coldsoldr
description: Tape saturation, wobble (wow and flutter) and age, in stereo at every position: te-op1-cfw's kennel effect tape_drive 0.3 (coldsoldr, GPL-3.0-or-later; the wobble after Mutable Instruments Beads' WowAndFlutter, MIT, rewritten in fixed point; hiir's halfband design, WTFPL). Blue saturate, green wobble, white age (clockwise = newer tape), orange mix; fn + blue the input gain into the saturation (-6..+6 dB), shift + fn + blue its fine.
